Title:COMMITTEE ON DISTRICT COUNCILS AND FUNCTIONS OF CITY COUNCIL AND RURAL BOARD
MPs Speaking:Inche Abdul Hamid Bin Haji Jumat (Minister for Local Government, Lands and Housing); Mr D. S. Marshall (Chief Minister and Minister for Commerce and Industry); Mr J. M. Jumabhoy (Assistant Minister for Commerce and Industry); Mr John Ede; Mr Lee Kuan Yew; Mr R. Jumabhoy; Mr G. E. N. Oehlers (Mr Speaker);
    Inche Abdul Hamid Bin Haji Jumat: One point that I would like to clarify here, Sir, is this: that I am only seeking the approval of this Assembly for the appointment of a committee and that committee will be appointed by the Government and not by the House.

Column: 306



    Sir, as regards certain allegations made by Members of the Opposition, particularly the question of time - some Members have said that they received the Notice Paper only yesterday - I would like to refer the Members concerned, with all due respect to you, Sir, to Standing Order No. 22 (3).

    On question put, the House divided: Ayes, 26; Noes, 4; Abstention, 1.

    Resolved,

    That this Assembly is of the opinion that a Committee should be appointed to enquire into the desirability of decentralising the powers and functions of the City Council and the Rural Board and in particular:
